instruction_summary: Re-estimate Besley-Persson (AER 2009) Tables 1-2 with outcomes rolled to 2000-2024 on successor instruments and history optionally extended to 2024 behind succession gates; grade war/parliamentary/legal-origin/democracy patterns persist/weaken/reverse out of sample (Branch R, deposit pending).

steps.description: Env + sha256 verify all staged files (Block A1)
Extract V-Dem core columns from RData via R (A4 pre-1950 assertion: e_polity2 back to 1789 present)
Build outcome battery Y1-Y10 + Y2/Y3 bridges (Block C)
Succession gates G1-G5 (Block A3) - all pass
Paper-era anchors + rolled Table1/2 estimates + C4 income rerun (Blocks B,D)

key_results.R-war: persists between regions (X1: 8/8 p<0.05), weakens within (3/8); X0 weakens both
key_results.R-parl: weakens (all four grid cells; positive sign 8/8, significance short of persists)
key_results.R-dem: new out-of-sample pattern (democracy becomes significant positive predictor, 5-7/8 between)
key_results.C4_income_rerun: holds (war + legal origins positive & significant, same signs)
key_results.gates: G1-G5 all pass (G2 reproduces preview 0.9245/k0.8493 exactly)

comparison_to_original.original: positive, significant across Tables 1-2 (printed; e.g. T1c1 0.510***, T2 0.555**-0.762***)
comparison_to_original.followup: X1 between: positive & p<0.05 in all 8 successor outcomes (persists); X1 within: 3/8 (weakens)
comparison_to_original.source_file: AER 2009 pp.1237-1238 (printed cells; Branch R pending-deposit) vs results/table1_update.csv, table2_update.csv
comparison_to_original.note: persists between regions, weakens within - the paper's own fn-20 pattern
undiminished / slightly stronger out of sample

comparison_to_original.original: significant for investor protection, ICRG, income-tax/GDP, tax/GDP (printed)
comparison_to_original.followup: weakens: positive sign 8/8 but p<0.05 in only 4/8 (X1 between)

comparison_to_original.original: positive, significant across tables (printed, several suspect cells pending-deposit)

comparison_to_original.followup: new out-of-sample pattern: significant positive in 5-7/8 columns between regions
comparison_to_original.note: reported as new pattern, not paper error

deviations: Branch R: no AER.dta deposit and no Phase-1 reconstruction estimate file on disk; paper-era anchors are the PRINTED AER cells, suspect set reported pending-deposit (no typo adjudicated, no suspect-cell stars used as prose evidence).
Attenuation-clause standardized anchors reconstructed in-study (paper X0 spec on GFDD/V-Dem/GRD 1980-2000 windows) because no Phase-1 estimate file exists; tagged pending-deposit.
NBER w13028 WP not staged -> typo-table WP cross-check column unavailable (honest exclusion; suspect-cell |t| arithmetic independently re-verified).
X0 war reconstruction corr 0.61 with authors' avg_war00 (window/coding/independence differences); X1 (avg_war00) used as headline generation as the spec designates.
